snippet.title: Scraps Of The Machine Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay.
Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

Wishlist  now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4041580/Scraps_Of_The_Machine/

Developed by Knight Division Games LLC
Music by One Man Symphony - Collateral Damage
